about: Every settings section, its owner and scopes. owner: "cadence" = a Cadence.Management.Settings host section; an application key = that application's settings_sections; "console" = added by Cadence.Management.ConsoleSettings only. host: true = the host still has a settings.section contribution for it (frontend/apps/host/src/settings/contributions.ts; dropped when §11c C deletes SettingsPage.vue). Guarded by apps/cadence_web/test/cadence_web/settings_sections_golden_test.exs (server and console) and frontend/apps/host/src/settings/contributions.golden.test.ts (host).
